note: Native visual reconstruction of visible nodes and text in the supplied PNG. Not a runnable ComfyUI workflow. Hidden nodes and covered IDs are not invented; internal IDs 201 and 202 identify source nodes whose badges are covered. Preview photographs are cropped from the supplied image.

text.value:
任务：将输入图像反推为供 Marble 世界模型生成可探索三维场景使用的空间描述，以图像证据为准。
1. 场景布局：以初始观察点为参照，说明近景、中景、远景的分层，以及主体的左右、前后、相邻和遮挡关系；不要把二维画面位置直接当作三维坐标。
2. 主体几何：提取主要建筑、地形、植被和道具的数量、体块、朝向、相对尺度、间距及连接方式。没有尺度参照时，不编造米数、坐标或精确尺寸。
3. 地面与空间：说明地面起伏、水陆边界、路径和可见空隙，明确物体与地面、水面或支撑结构的接触关系，保持合理的深度与透视。
4. 可见性：区分可见事实与推测。遮挡背面、图外区域和未提供的视角应保持不确定，不擅自添加建筑、房间、道路或人物；延展区域只保持已有结构的保守连续。
5. 材质与光照：描述主要材质、颜色、粗糙或光滑特征，以及光源方向、软硬、阴影和天气；保留原画风，避免把绘画笔触、反射或天空纹理误判成实体几何。
6. 全景一致性：若输入为 2:1 等距柱状全景，按同一连续空间理解左右接缝、地平线与天空—地面关系；接缝处同一主体只计一次，不将极区拉伸还原为异常体块。
输出：仅给出一段可直接使用的英文场景提示词，约 180—240 词，依次组织环境与主体、空间与尺度、地形与材质、光照与连续性约束。使用客观空间语言，对不确定信息保持保守；不输出分析过程、代码或 JSON，不写文学评价，也不声称图像能够保证精确尺寸、完整背面或可通行性。

nodes.title: 展示文本 · 原始示例

text.value: The scene is a serene and expansive rural landscape, depicted in a painterly style with a vibrant and calming atmosphere under a clear blue sky. A single, rustic thatched hut with wooden walls stands centrally, nestled amongst fields of tall green grass and scattered white rocks. The hut features a dark, recessed doorway and a small window, with a weathered wooden structure extending from its front, perhaps serving as a small porch or working area. To the right of the hut, a small wooden cart or tool bench rests among the rocks. The landscape gently slopes upwards in the distance, revealing undulating hills covered in lush green vegetation and dotted with darker patches of trees. Large, fluffy white clouds drift across the bright blue sky, with a flock of small birds soaring high above the distant hills. To the left, a mature tree with a dense canopy provides shade. The ground around the hut is uneven, with patches of bare earth interspersed with the green grass and numerous light-colored, rounded rocks. The hut is the focal point, positioned slightly left of center, with the rocky area in front of it. The large tree is located to the far left, while the distant hills and clouds stretch across the horizon.

title.zh: 反推要求 · 服务三维生成

copy.zh: 将画面转成空间约束：近中远景、主体体块与相对尺度、遮挡与接地、地形和光照。全景需保持接缝与地平线连续；不可见区域不臆造，避免把绘画或投影畸变当作真实几何。
copy.en: Extract spatial constraints: depth layers, object volumes and relative scale, occlusion and ground contact, terrain and lighting. Preserve panorama continuity; avoid inventing hidden areas or turning painterly marks and projection distortion into geometry.

title.zh: 文本输出 · 补充语义

copy.zh: 将草屋、岩石、稻田、远山与积云转成文字条件。全景提供视觉信息，描述补充语义，接下来一起交给 Marble。
copy.en: Turn the hut, rocks, paddy fields, distant hills and clouds into text conditions. The panorama supplies visual information; the description adds semantic guidance. Both continue to Marble.
